newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oriental Land falls on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Land falls on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in Oriental Land Co Ltd fell amid profit-taking in Wednesday morning trade on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, brokers said.
Shares in the company were down 110 yen at 7,990 yen at 0124 GMT.
Oriental Land operates the Tokyo Disneyland theme park near Tokyo.
Market participants have been buying Oriental Land shares in recent sessions on expectations that the company would announce a gift to its shareholders.
The company said on Tuesday it would give shareholders a one-day pass to the theme park once a year. A pass will be given for every 100 shares held. A single shareholder can receive up to 10 passes.
